memo: TPU paired eval, no submit (GPU week used up until ~10-17). tpueval-6 showed v11's prompt rules cannot stop the missing old_string in edit_file (861 events), while run_command had 0. v12 (submission/) removes edit_file from v7 and edits via run_command Python heredocs. This run installs pytest 8.3.4 and the test deps (inline-snapshot, dirty-equals, ...) into the eval venv, stops before the agent runs if no reference patch passes (gold gate), then runs v7 vs v12 serially on the 14 GPU-calibrated tasks. Pass for v12: MISSINGARG = 0 and v12 >= v7 + 2 -> confirm on the 72 healthy tasks, then submit g4v12-1.
message: tpueval-7: test deps + gold gate + v7 vs v12 on the 14 GPU-calibrated tasks
